root_cause_criterion.criterion: Immediately after the strings-fallback `plist_free(*plist)` call, `plist_from_openstep()` must clear the output parameter before the retry parse can fail and return control to the caller.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable fallback branch frees the first parsed node and leaves `*plist` pointing at that freed node while the retry parse runs. The fixed code inserts `*plist = NULL;` at the same site, so the caller-side cleanup no longer inherits a dangling out-parameter when the retry fails.

nodes.state: `plist_free_node()` receives the stale pointer as its `node` argument, and the immediately following `node->parent` evaluation is the AddressSanitizer heap-use-after-free read.
The harness reaches `plist_free(root_node)` with `root_node` still equal to the pointer freed earlier in `plist_from_openstep()`, so this second cleanup call reuses the stale node pointer.

edges.relation: The stale `*plist` value left after the fallback free survives the failed retry parse and reaches the caller unchanged as `root_node`, so the later `plist_free(root_node)` runs after the earlier free on that same pointer.
The harness forwards the same `root_node` value unchanged into `plist_free_node(node)`, where the freed node pointer becomes the sink argument.
